# Server configuration

The server reads its configuration from environment variables. It reads no configuration file.
Check a configuration with `impluvium-server config check`: the command validates the environment, prints the effective settings without secrets and exits. It starts no listener, opens no database connection and runs no migration.

## Variables

| Variable | File variant | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IMPLUVIUM_EXTERNAL_URL` | - | origin URL | yes | none | Public origin of the server, for example https://impluvium.example. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_DATA_DIR` | - | absolute path | yes | none | Directory for server data. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_LIBRARY_DIR` | - | absolute path | no | `library` inside the data directory | Directory that holds the game library. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | - | comma-separated CIDR networks | no | empty; no proxy is trusted | Networks of reverse proxies whose forwarding headers are trusted. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_INSECURE_LAN` | - | `true` or `false` | no | `false` | Allows a plain http external origin on a local network. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `DATABASE_URL_FILE` | PostgreSQL URL | yes | none | PostgreSQL connection URL, including the password. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_DB_POOL_MAX` | - | integer from 1 to 500 | no | `10` | Largest number of database connections in the pool. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_DB_POOL_MIN` | - | integer from 0 to 500 | no | `0` | Number of database connections kept open; at most the maximum. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_DB_TIMEOUT_SECS` | - | integer from 1 to 300 | no | `30` | Seconds to wait for a free database connection. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_SPA_DIR` | - | absolute path | no | none | Directory with the built web application. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_LOG` | - | log filter | no | `info` | Log filter: a level, or target=level directives separated by commas. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_LOG_FORMAT` | - | one of `text`, `json` | no | `text` | Format of log lines. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_BACKUP_MODE` | - | one of `auto`, `command`, `off` | no | `auto` | How the backup before pending migrations is made. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_BACKUP_COMMAND` | - | JSON array of strings | no | none; required when the backup mode is `command` | Operator backup program and arguments, started without a shell. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_BACKUP_TIMEOUT_SECS` | - | integer from 1 to 86400 | no | `3600` | Seconds after which a running backup is stopped and counted as failed. |

## Secrets

A secret can be given directly or through a file. For `DATABASE_URL`, set either the variable itself or `DATABASE_URL_FILE` with the path of a file that holds the value, such as a container secret.
Setting both is an error. The file must be a regular file of at most 65536 bytes, readable by the server, valid UTF-8 and not empty. One trailing line break is removed.

## Validation

- The external origin has a scheme, a host and optionally a port, but no path, query or credentials. A plain `http` origin is accepted only for this machine (`localhost`, any name ending in `.localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8` and `::1`) or when `IMPLUVIUM_INSECURE_LAN` is `true`. Use `https` otherwise; the server itself may sit behind a TLS proxy and speak plain http to it.
- Paths must be absolute.
- A trusted proxy is a network such as `192.0.2.10/32` (a single IPv4 address) or `2001:db8::10/128` (a single IPv6 address), with no bits set below the prefix length. List the addresses of your proxies only, with `/32` or `/128`, and not whole networks: every machine in a trusted network can set the client address of its requests.  The prefix length 0 is refused because it would trust every address, and so is any network inside the IPv4-mapped range `::ffff:0:0/96`: write IPv4 networks in IPv4 notation.
- The pool minimum must not exceed the pool maximum.
- `IMPLUVIUM_BACKUP_COMMAND` is required when `IMPLUVIUM_BACKUP_MODE` is `command` and refused otherwise. It is a JSON array with the program first; the server starts it without a shell. Do not put secrets into the arguments: `config check` shows only the program and one placeholder per argument.
- Booleans are exactly `true` or `false`. Names are case-sensitive.
- Error messages name the variable and the rule. They never repeat a value.

## Unknown variables

Every variable that starts with `IMPLUVIUM_` and is not listed above is an error, and the message suggests the closest known name. This catches typos and names of features that the server does not read yet. The variables `IMPLUVIUM_VERSION`, `IMPLUVIUM_GIT_REF` and `IMPLUVIUM_BUILD_PROFILE` belong to the build and are ignored.
The server does not accept the variable names of earlier releases as aliases.
